en-US.title: "What does reading have to do with faith?" It is a matter of survival, not culture | Professor Ki...
en-US.description:
“What does reading books have to do with faith?”

Isn’t reading the Bible well enough?

There are times when you wonder if you really need to read difficult books.

However, God spoke to us not through mysterious means, but through ‘human language’ and ‘books.’

Books keep us alive, help us realize that we are not alone, and lead us beyond ourselves to a wider world.

In this video, I would like to share how someone who used to find books difficult—rather than someone who reads well—has expanded their faith and life through ‘survival reading’!

It is okay if you cannot read many books.

But a single book can change your thoughts and faith 📕
